from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689794/attempts/a536beb1a07649f1b9f85ee1d72dd80c/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Locate full horizontal and vertical separator lines, whose color is distinct from the background.
    bg=grid[0][0]
    hr=next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg)
    vc=next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and grid[0][c]!=bg)
    rows=[(0,hr),(hr+1,h)]
    cols=[(0,vc),(vc+1,w)]
    # The populated chamber is the one with most non-background cells.
    chambers=[]
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(rows):
        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(cols):
            cells=[grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)]
            chambers.append((sum(v!=bg for v in cells),ri,ci,(r0,r1,c0,c1)))
    _,_,_,(sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1)=max(chambers)
    pattern=[row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1 in rows:
        for c0,c1 in cols:
            if (r0,r1,c0,c1)==(sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1):
                continue
            for dr,r in enumerate(range(r0,r1)):
                for dc,c in enumerate(range(c0,c1)):
                    out[r][c]=pattern[dr][dc]
    return out

# Write standalone task program
src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    hr = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg)
    vc = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and grid[0][c] != bg)
    rows = [(0, hr), (hr + 1, h)]
    cols = [(0, vc), (vc + 1, w)]
    chambers = []
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(rows):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(cols):
            count = sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            chambers.append((count, (r0, r1, c0, c1)))
    _, (sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1) = max(chambers)
    pattern = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1 in rows:
        for c0, c1 in cols:
            if (r0, r1, c0, c1) == (sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1):
                continue
            for dr, r in enumerate(range(r0, r1)):
                for dc, c in enumerate(range(c0, c1)):
                    out[r][c] = pattern[dr][dc]
    return out
'''
